newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia shares ease in flagging market.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia shares ease in flagging market.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 1.15 percent on Monday and traders said a gradual decline could be expected throughout the week due to lack of demand from foreign and consequently domestic investors.
"I think shares could fall by up to another five percent this week as foreigners are not buying which consequently diminishes domestic investors' interest," one broker said.
She said index growth could only be expected in the second half of August when buyers are expected to start coming back for a fresh investment cycle in September.
* The SBI index fell 17.82 points to 1,534.84.
* Pharmaceutical producer Lek was most actively traded, down 0.7 percent to 35,250 tolars on volume of 2,348 shares. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
